description: Just-in-time (JIT) compilation using FFCx and CFFI.

functions.name: ffcx_jit
functions.description: Compile UFL object with FFCx and CFFI. Returns a three-tuple (compiled_object, module, (header, implementation)).
notes: Option priority (high to low): jit_options API > $PWD/dolfinx_jit_options.json > $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/dolfinx/dolfinx_jit_options.json > DOLFINX_DEFAULT_JIT_OPTIONS

functions.name: get_options
functions.description: Return a copy of the merged JIT option values for DOLFINx.

functions.name: mpi_jit_decorator
functions.description: Decorator for JIT compilation in parallel. First process compiles, others use cache.
